liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): Reviewer singles out the Scarlet into Fire pairing as blazing hot and a reason to get the recording; Reviewer finds the Scarlet into Fire insane and underrated [25][27][35]
- **New Speedway Boogie** (1 review): New Speedway Boogie into Promised Land is described as a hot ending to the first set [27]
- **Fire On The Mountain** (1 review): Jerry's first solo in Fire On The Mountain is singled out as shredding [33]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mickey's Thing**: rare: 3 archived performances [37]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-06-12.aud.andrewf.86096.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 166 min [1]
- **gd1992-06-12.aud.andrewf.86095.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 166 min [2]
- **gd1992-06-12.169061.fixed.165919.mc.rogosa.flac1644**: source not stated; 21 songs; 162 min [3]. Said about its sound: An earlier seed had a muddy, distant side A lacking treble; a better transfer followed after the Dragon deck was restored [3]
- **gd1992-06-12.165919.me88.mc.rogosa.flac1644**: source not stated; 21 songs; 163 min [5]. Said about its sound: Side A of each cassette sounds muddy and distant; Ozone EQ brightened it, and quality shifts noticeably after Black Throated Wind [5]
- **gd92-06-12.bk4011.Fochesato.4882.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 162 min; rated 4.62/5 by 8 [14]. Said about its sound: Reviewer is unhappy with the audience recording's quality, rating the sound lower than the show; Reviewer calls it a superb ambient recording with great punch and detail, and a reference disc; Attendee prefers the audience version, believing the soundboard runs fast [32][33][34][35]

## Around the show

- Hornsby did not play these shows; his tenure with the band ended March 24, 1992, at The Palace [34]
- Reviewer says Jerry's MIDI horn guitar jams in Fire are among the best of the 1990s [27]
- Reviewer thinks this was probably the best show of the 1990s [28]
- Reviewer ranks it third among about 75 shows seen, behind 6/17/91 and 6/14/91 [35]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-06-12.aud.andrewf.86096.flac1648**: taped by Andrew F.; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Set One: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP-4 shotgun capsules > Casio DA-7 > Sony DT-Dat tape. Mics on 7-foot stand in OTS.%0DSet Two: Schoeps CMC3/MK4 (ORTF) > Oade… [1]. Also: Second-set tape failed during the show, so that set was cloned afterward; Taped and transferred in June 2007 by Andrew F; Soundforge fades, TLH for FLAC and checksums [1]
- **gd1992-06-12.aud.andrewf.86095.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Andrew F; transferred by Andrew F; source: Nakamichi CM-300's with CP-4 shotgun capsules > Casio DA-7 > Sony DT-Dat tape. Mics on 7-foot stand in OTS. Schoeps CMC3/MK4 (ORTF) > Oade mic power supply >… [2]. Also: Second-set tape failed at the show; set cloned afterward, with a seamless break between disc 2 track 7 and disc 3 track 1; Taped and transferred in June 2007 by Andrew F; Soundforge fades, TLH used for SBE-OK, FLAC and checksums [2]
- **gd1992-06-12.169061.fixed.165919.mc.rogosa.flac1644**: taped by Dan Rogosa; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: 2x Senn ME88s (stand, OTS) > TCD-D3 > line out > TC-D5 (Dolby B) taped by Dan Rogosa [3]
- **gd1992-06-12.165919.me88.mc.rogosa.flac1644**: taped by Dan Rogosa; transferred by Mark Goldey; source: Source: 2x Senn ME88s (stand, OTS) > TCD-D3 > line out > TC-D5 (Dolby B) taped by Dan Rogosa [5]. Also: Taped by Dan Rogosa, facilitated by Charlie Miller; cassettes with a Space patch from his DAT, pitch corrected [5]
- **gd92-06-12.bk4011.Fochesato.4882.sbeok.shnf**: source: (FOB)B+K 4011 > DAT > CDR/? > EAC > CDR > EAC > SHNv3 [14]

Reviewer thinks this was probably the best show of the 1990s

Gain rises during Jack Straw, so the sound needs a couple of minutes to settle
Hornsby did not play these shows; his tenure with the band ended March 24, 1992, at The Palace

Jerry's MIDI horn guitar jams in Scarlet into Fire are top form; the transition between them is praised
Reviewer thinks the audience recording is probably better than the soundboard
Second-set tape failed during the show, so that set was cloned afterward

An earlier seed had a muddy, distant side A lacking treble; a better transfer followed after the Dragon deck was restored
